notes: Printed: 'two 3/3 colorless Golem ARTIFACT creature tokens', then 'Each other artifact you control becomes a copy'. After mode one makes the two Golem tokens, a second Masterful Replication (mode two, target Alpha Golem) turns each of them into a copy of Alpha Golem: they are artifacts, so both are affected (name Alpha Golem; they are still tokens, token-ness is not a copiable value). Neither is still named Golem.
